✍️ 3 conditions that protect you when you make an offer

1️⃣ Bond approval: no approval by the agreed date, no deal, no penalty
2️⃣ Sale of your current home, if you need to sell first
3️⃣ Inspection: time to inspect and report defects

Also check the occupation date, occupational rent, which fixtures are included and who pays for the certificates.

An offer becomes a binding contract once both sides sign. Read it before you sign it. Comment OFFER. 👇
